_comment: What the market's stalls look like. Prices are not here: they are engine tuning, and live in data/game-balance.tres beside the yields and the tax rates. Engine data, not a campaign's: every realm's market works the same. 'step' is how much the amount moves per press. A stall with a 'rack' is not traded itself: it is a counter you pick off, and each entry on it trades on its own terms. Every number here is placeholder balance, meant to be tuned.

goods.name: Grain
goods.blurb: Essential food for your people. Keeps your realm strong and growing.

goods.name: Cattle
goods.blurb: Meat on the hoof. Slower to raise than grain, and worth more at the gate.

goods.name: Wood
goods.blurb: Beams, shafts and bow staves. Everything a province builds starts here.

goods.name: Stone
goods.blurb: Cut blocks for walls and keeps. Heavy to haul, and priced accordingly.

goods.name: Iron
goods.blurb: Pig iron for the forge. Nothing with an edge on it is made without this.

goods.name: Weapons
goods.blurb: Arms off the rack, bought finished instead of waiting on the forge.

rack.name: Swords
rack.blurb: Forged blades, ready for the hands that will carry them.

rack.name: Bows
rack.blurb: Staves and strings, the cheapest reach a province can buy.

rack.name: Crossbows
rack.blurb: Slow to wind, but a bolt goes through mail where an arrow turns.

rack.name: Pikes
rack.blurb: Ash and iron by the bundle. Nothing stops a horse cheaper.

rack.name: Maces
rack.blurb: Heavy heads for the work plate armour makes of a sword.

rack.name: Horses
rack.blurb: Trained warhorses, sold with the harness that makes them cavalry.
